name: @huddle/ui
description: Boardwalk design system: the only place in Huddle that holds colors, type, and shadow tokens.
//exports: The root entry is tokens only and imports nothing from React, which is what keeps it (and color-literals.test.ts) runnable under plain Node. Components live behind `./native`, whose react-native import resolves to whichever variant the consuming app installed — react-native-tvos on the TV, stock on the phone — which is exactly why it is a peer dependency.
